name: Convolutional Networks
strandNote: Not needed for the quant path. Machine learning research roles that work with images, grids or signals.
description: Build convolution from a rolling mean, count what a layer costs, and train a small CNN on digits in NumPy.

skills.cnn-conv: Convolution as a sliding dot product

levels.name: Convolution as a sliding dot product

requires.why: A rolling mean from l10 is the first convolution; the level starts from it.
A kernel is learned with the NumPy array autograd built in that level.
The density of a sum is a convolution, from l16; a quick check helps.
Training the CNN uses the optimisers, initialisation and normalisation of those two levels.
The baseline is the small network of l17, and classifiers are scored as in level 3.
Accuracy is reported once on held-out digits, after choices made on a validation split.

lessonNames.l1-rolling-mean-is-convolution: A rolling mean is a convolution

lessonObjectives.l1-rolling-mean-is-convolution: Write a rolling mean as a convolution with a kernel, and match it to pandas.
lessonObjectives.l2-kernels-that-detect: Design one-dimensional kernels that smooth, difference or detect a pattern, and read their outputs.
lessonObjectives.l3-convolution-in-2d: Write a two-dimensional convolution and apply edge kernels to a small image.
lessonObjectives.l4-learning-a-kernel: Learn a planted kernel by gradient descent with the array autograd, and check its gradient.
lessonObjectives.l5-stride-and-padding: Derive the output size of a convolution from its input, kernel, stride and padding.
lessonObjectives.l6-pooling: Write max and average pooling, and say what each throws away.
lessonObjectives.l7-counting-parameters: Count the parameters and multiply-adds of a convolutional layer, and compare them with a dense one.
lessonObjectives.l8-im2col: Build im2col so that a convolution becomes one matrix product, and check it against the loop.
lessonObjectives.l9-reading-digits: Run a CNN forward on the digits data from supplied weights, and read its confusion matrix.
lessonObjectives.l10-training-the-cnn: Train a small CNN on digits with the array autograd to a stated held-out accuracy.
lessonObjectives.l11-a-residual-block: Build a residual block and explain why the identity path helps a deeper net train.
lessonObjectives.l12-shifted-digits: Test a CNN and a same-size MLP on digits shifted one pixel, and explain the gap.
